info.name: Arunachal Literature Fest API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection v2.1 for the Arunachal Literature Festival backend (Node.js/Express).

**Base path:** `/api/v1`

**Auth:** JWT via `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` or httpOnly cookie `token`.

**Workflow:**
1. GET `/api/v1/captcha/generate`
2. POST `/api/v1/onboarding/login` (saves `token` collection variable from Set-Cookie)
3. Call protected endpoints with Bearer {{token}}

**Note:** Server default PORT is `7642` if env PORT is unset; set `baseUrl` accordingly (default http://localhost:5000).
